name: Home Screen Manager
description: TEST BUILD — Designs, orders, and renders hybrid Jellyfin/Abyss home sections using manual media, collections, metadata tags, and libraries.
overview: TEST BUILD — Home Screen Manager creation, ordering, rendering, and Abyss customization for Jellyfin 10.11.11.

versions.changelog: Adds a text-only draggable Manual ordering list and persists its exact item order; fixes home-screen injection by registering a direct File Transformation write-service callback for Jellyfin 10.11.11; adds visible-home lifecycle retries and integration diagnostics; and reports success only after the section is saved, integration is registered, and the browser client loads. Requires Abyss, Collection Manager, and File Transformation 2.5.11.0.
